items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Hank Jones, Eddie Jones, Benny Green, and a number of -- Paul Quinichette -- a number of stars were on this recording. Joe Newman recommended me...

ctx.x: Now I want to maybe make the transition to how you got from there to Basie, unless there’s some other aspect of your time there or the military experience that’s either musically or personally significant to you.

Yes. In February of 1953 -- I was scheduled to be released in May, so in February of 1953 I got a hold of a Down Beat magazine. I saw a picture of the Basie orchestra with inset photos of Paul Quinichette and Eddie “Lockjaw” Davis. I remember saying to myself, “Man, I sure would like to be in that band,” not realizing that less then four months I would sitting in that band. I got out in May. I went back to Detroit, and I freelanced around Detroit. I played with Kenny Burrell.
So it seemed like Detroit was home now.
